question: Does the specific two-light-stratum noncompetition counterexample from the previous overlap audit use light responses quantitatively compatible with the published light odds-ratio coefficients, and can a single-common-intercept light-only model generate 5 EXPECTED ramet co-presences?

source.data_quality: Paper's ORs are adjusted published associations; their exact model level is not the same as a ramet-level probability model. Journal live full text currently blocked in browser, so treat original OR coefficients as provisional previously transcribed numbers pending verification against authors' accessible PDF.
source.source_of_2024_thesis: 2024 Seoul National University master's thesis by Jae Yeon Jang concerns the SAME system and is not independent replication.

model_conditions: RLI x in [0,100] literal percentage points
Only light covariate with logistic(p_S(x))=alpha_S+ln(1.009)*x, logistic(p_A(x))=alpha_A+ln(0.979)*x
One common intercept alpha per butterfly across all study ramets, no site/month intercepts, interactions or random effects
Species outcomes independent conditional on the same measured x for expectation calculations
Marginal expected species frequencies constrained to S=209/875, A=129/875; not assuming the original raw light histogram known
No correction of paper's quadrat 255 vs 215 discrepancy; this model uses internally consistent RAMET counts only
quantities: Implied per-percentage-point light ORs of the previous invented 400 sunny 475 shady two-stratum toy, using conditional species occurrence proportions in each class across x=0 and x=100
Rigorous lower bound on expected co-use for ANY distribution of 875 ramets' x values under the common-intercept S logistic slope: 129 * logistic(logit(209/875)-100*ln(1.009))

Numerical minimum EXPECTED co-use over two-class mixtures of light x=0 and 100, optimizing fraction of x=100 hosts and intercepts to match observed marginal expected S,A numbers; this is a restricted two-point stress test NOT a proven unrestricted optimum
Sensitivity to alternate plausible OR values from any published 95% intervals if exact source confirmed; do not claim formal uncertainty interval from unverified OR confidence bounds
interpreting_results: Mathematical incompatibility under a deliberately restricted fitted-slope and single-intercept model DOES NOT prove actual interspecific competition. Other microhabitat covariates, site/month baseline heterogeneity, nonlinear habitat selection, detection, species behavior and dataset level differences remain. Observed 5 can occur stochastically even if mean expected >5.
stop: Do not optimize invented niche classes until they mimic the observed co-use and then call the tuned example independent field evidence. Do not assert the toy class counts are Korean observations. Do not validate paper coefficients against unavailable original ramet records.
